inputs.rule_text: gc_round_requests: a fold round reads GET 17 + 1 per new manifest + 1 per ref log record of every table tail since its last snapshot (cas_tables x tail), PUT 5, LIST 4; a Deferred round GET 12, PUT 1, LIST 3; each manual round adds one heartbeat pulse (GET 1, PUT 1); the base terms do not depend on cas_tables
inputs.listing_rule: per table one catalog GET and one LIST of _files/ every cas_table_cleanup_period_s (305 s idle, 60 s under load: assumption), 1-12 per table in 12 minutes
inputs.insert_rule: fresh Compact part: HEAD 1, PUT 9, GET 7 per insert, plus 1 GET per table life (the first transaction reads _ckpt once more)

GetObject.reason: inserts plus 0-12 cleanup listings per table outside the rounds

ListObjectsV2.reason: cleanup listings outside the rounds; one inside a round is maintenance

source_refs.claim: SYSTEM CAS GC RUN runs one synchronous round
a round with no changed shard and no due graduation is Deferred: no fold
each ref transaction appends one immutable _log object (create-only PUT)
a round that acquires the lease pulses once more
one pulse is a GET of gc/hb and one conditional PUT
a _snap snapshot is published after more than 256 log records or 1 MiB of tail
idle cleanup runs sleep max_cleanup_delay_period plus up to cleanup_delay_period_random_add
it iterates the table directory: on CAS a catalog GET and a LIST of the namespace files
